plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. Dominant strategy: bid my true value to maximize expected long-run profit. Overbidding risks negative payoff if I win and pay above value; underbidding risks losing positive-profit wins. I will bid my value $9. ]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid your value $40) is weakly dominant: it maximizes expected surplus and avoids the winner's curse. No prior history to exploit; ties are rare and resolved randomly. I will bid 40.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding my true private value is a weakly dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit. Given my value $32 and bids in $0.1 increments, I will bid $32. This ensures I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below my value, maximizing long-run payoff.]
